contract_groups.id: arch shape and shared physical sections
contract_groups.comparison: ArchGeometry private fields retain one solid centre/size and optional wall frame, plus raw span/spring/rise/radius selected by exact ResolvedSolidShape. from_solid rejects unrelated shape but does not validate raw arch relationships; pointed rise derives apex-spring and segmental crown divides by raw rise. Fixed24 subdivisions feed paired front quad/depth, both visible and collision strip consumers share this section recipe. Existing NativeF005 shape/envelope aggregate relationship applies; this adapter does not supply the missing accepted-shape contract. Zero wall tangent normalizes invalidly; no actual bad accepted wall or new unique graph established. Panel versus ring intentionally reverses which part of the same crown is filled.

contract_groups.id: cuboid checked leaves and correlated topology
contract_groups.comparison: CollisionCuboid from_metres preserves source ID and checks centre,size,three radians in source order; manual native Deserialize routes same complete record through same factory. Fields individually typed, zero extent valid; identity membership is not a constructor promise. Corners private[Position;8] is filled by one pose/sign-bit topology and checks each computed point before Self. Exactly12 constant pairs use indices0..7 and each differing single sign bit, so no independent caller edge list/row alignment. Original fixture checks degree3 and all unique undirected edges. bounds deliberately computes a separately rounded centre/half envelope, while floor contact uses actual corner-derived sections; do not require bit-identical alternate reductions.

Compiler builds ID map from actual resolved solids, selected ID set from unreplaced wall hosts, fixed gable/heating/frame/workplace and semantic-role lists, then actual solid lookup and fallible shape projection. BTreeSet deduplicates selected identities; raw duplicate solid IDs overwrite and raw missing references filter out, so this API relies on accepted BuildingPlan identity graph rather than sealing arbitrary public plan. No normal broken input/collision failure asserted. Dynamic doors intentionally separate; not every roof is static collision. Bar source IDs and checked placement copied together. Enclosing bounds start from checked plan footprint then union each cuboid bounds; this intentionally includes empty footprint space, not an exact occupied-area union. Raw public BuildingCollision decode does not recompute that aggregate; no new specific downstream misuse proven. Ground contact recomputes from cuboids and ignores independently supplied overall bounds.

contract_groups.id: arch native projection failure versus successful result
contract_groups.comparison: collision_parts branches cylinder/bell to separate actual lower obligations; other nonarches reuse checked envelope. Arch strips generate conservative boxes from SAME front+depth eight points projected into one local frame, checked constructor keeps original solid ID on geometry failure. Finite source leaves alone do not guarantee finite intermediate min+max or shape crown; no silent assumption that successful raw ArchGeometry is a checked shape. Local Vec<Result> collection returns no completed BuildingCollision if a projected cuboid rejects. Other lower modules declared here retain independent inventory, not body credit.

contract_groups.id: coherent disjoint render product and mutable membership
contract_groups.comparison: BuildingKit borrows immutable plan, selects actual cuboid timber roles/material and skips face-selected gables, derives local size/rotation/world transform/UV phase from the same source, and records source in private excluded sets and public instances in one loop before Ok. Every completed normal new has disjoint residual/instanced membership. Public instances.clear permits later safe mutation while private excluded remains; detail and facade still receive original exclusions. This independently supports exact Camera07F044/CONTRACT226; no extra Native unique finding. Correct repair is canonical immutable compiled membership/read-only iteration or derive omissions from canonical current instance membership, preserving facade subset, UV phase, world/local normals and source IDs. No normal edit/rendered-hole or run claim.

Full collision inline tests check ground-datum contact excludes high/buried projection, rotated extent contains corners, door void absence, timber floor/stair/landing source membership and permanent window bars; full admission tests include zero-Y and negative leaf rejection/source diagnostic, postcard native record roundtrip. Full kit external test compares component topology/material/transformed positions/normals/UV, then total triangles of residual+instances for detail and facade across three archetypes. These are actual source facts only, not executed checks or a proof arbitrary plan/source IDs are valid. External collision/arch_tests declaration remains independently unread, no implicit full fixture coverage.
